page_title: ACM 1-1 GEN | AC Milan v Genoa 08/01/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+10' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.

90+9' Nicolae Stanciu (Genoa) doesn't keep his cool and fails to convert the penalty. He skies the ball way over the bar and into the stands. The ball goes out of play and AC Milan will have a goal kick.
90+9' Whoa! Such gestures are commonly penalised and Fikayo Tomori (AC Milan) duly receives a yellow card.
90+9' Nicolae Stanciu (Genoa) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
90+8' Referee Maurizio Mariani is happy with his original decision after the VAR review. It’s a PENALTY to Genoa!
90+7' Strahinja Pavlovic (AC Milan) is punished with a yellow card for violating the rules.
90+7' The yellow card goes to Mike Maignan (AC Milan).
90+7' There's some confusion. Looks like the ref is going to review the penalty decision to Genoa using VAR. Let's see what happens.
90+6' An opponent rises to his feet after being downed by Davide Bartesaghi (AC Milan). Maurizio Mariani saw the sliding tackle and blows for a foul. PENALTY to Genoa! Great chance to score.
90+4' PENALTY APPEAL after Zachary Athekame (AC Milan) goes down under a challenge from the defender. All players chase the referee but he's not interested in the penalty claim. Play continues.

90+2' 1 - 1 Rafael Leao (AC Milan) outjumps the defence inside the six-yard box to meet the corner and scores with a great header into the bottom left corner. The keeper had no chance to react. The score is now 1:1.
90+2' Luka Modric (AC Milan) will try to find the head of one of his teammates from a corner kick.

90+2' The defence had a hard time blocking out the strike from Christian Pulisic (AC Milan). He didn't hesitate and finished from outside the box right after he had received a pass from his teammate. Now AC Milan have a corner.
90+1' Maurizio Mariani blows his whistle as Niclas Fullkrug (AC Milan) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack.
90' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
90' Davide Bartesaghi (AC Milan) puts a cross into the box from the corner but there is no panic from the opposition and they easily clear.

89' Zachary Athekame (AC Milan) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort. The referee signals a corner kick to AC Milan.

88' Christian Pulisic (AC Milan) meets a cross inside the penalty area and unloads a good attempt towards the left side of the goal. Nicola Leali is prepared, though, and denies him with a fantastic save.

86' Rafael Leao (AC Milan) rises high to head a nice lofted cross towards the right side of the goal. Unfortunately for him, his close-range effort lacks pace and Nicola Leali makes a comfortable save.
86' Adrien Rabiot (AC Milan) collects a pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender.
85' Davide Bartesaghi (AC Milan) floats the ball in from the corner but it's intercepted.

85' Zachary Athekame (AC Milan) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety. AC Milan will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
83' Daniele De Rossi has decided to make a change. Nicolae Stanciu (Genoa) replaces Aaron Martin.
83' Substitution. Sebastian Otoa (Genoa) replaces Lorenzo Colombo.
82' A lofted cross from Brooke Norton-Cuffy (Genoa) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.
80' The expression of the referee Maurizio Mariani is crystal clear. This behaviour won't be tolerated. Nicola Leali (Genoa) is shown a yellow card.
79' Patrizio Masini (Genoa) touches the ball with his hand.
79' The corner from Luka Modric (AC Milan) is cleared away by the defence.
78' Adrien Rabiot (AC Milan) attempts a long crossfield pass, but the defence does well to intercept the ball. AC Milan have been awarded a corner kick.

77' Christian Pulisic (AC Milan) attempts to score as he rises near the penalty spot and heads the ball to the bottom right corner of the goal. Nicola Leali displays brilliant reflexes and pulls off a comfortable save to stop the ball from hitting the net.
75' Massimiliano Allegri has decided to substitute Matteo Gabbia and he is replaced by Zachary Athekame (AC Milan).
75' Substitution. Vitinha leaves the pitch and is replaced by Jeff Ekhator (Genoa).
73' Luka Modric (AC Milan) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.
73' AC Milan quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
73' Davide Bartesaghi (AC Milan) delivers a crossfield pass, but the ball is cut out before it reaches its intended target. AC Milan get a corner.
71' Ruben Loftus-Cheek (AC Milan) thinks that he is fouled by his opponent, but the referee deems him to be the one who commits a foul and awards a free kick to the other team.
70' Matteo Gabbia (AC Milan) is shown a yellow card by the referee for making a challenge on his opponent, but he looks angry with the decision.
70' Rafael Leao (AC Milan) was too forceful with his tackle and Maurizio Mariani interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
68' The linesman signals that Niclas Fullkrug (AC Milan) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
65' Massimiliano Allegri decides to make a substitution. Alexis Saelemaekers will be replaced by Niclas Fullkrug (AC Milan).
65' Wasted opportunity. Davide Bartesaghi (AC Milan) gets to the rebound inside the box and smashes the ball just wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Genoa will have a goal kick.
64' Here's the change. Ruslan Malinovskyi leaves the pitch and Mikael Egill Ellertsson (Genoa) comes on as a substitute.
64' Here is a change. Morten Thorsby is going off and Daniele De Rossi gives the last tactical orders to Patrizio Masini (Genoa).
61' The goal by AC Milan is DISALLOWED on the advice of the video assistant referee due to a handball.
59' Wait! Referee Maurizio Mariani has indicated he is going to review the AC Milan goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was a handball in the build-up.
58' GOAL! The corner comes over and Matteo Gabbia wins a simple header before Christian Pulisic (AC Milan) nods the ball into the back of the net. 1:1.
58' Davide Bartesaghi (AC Milan) is about to take a corner kick.

58' This shall not pass! Adrien Rabiot (AC Milan) lines up a shot from the edge of the box and goes for goal, but the effort is well blocked by a defender. The ball goes out of play. AC Milan are awarded a corner kick.
58' AC Milan failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.

57' Davide Bartesaghi (AC Milan) swings in a dangerous cross from the resulting corner kick, but none of his teammates manage to outjump the defence. The referee blows his whistle, AC Milan are awarded a corner kick.
57' Luka Modric (AC Milan) unleashes a missile of a shot towards goal, but his good effort is blocked by one of the defenders.
56' Davide Bartesaghi (AC Milan) works the corner short instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
56' Davide Bartesaghi (AC Milan) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety. The ball goes out for a corner. AC Milan can continue in their attacking effort.
54' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Vitinha (Genoa) heads on.
54' Ruben Loftus-Cheek (AC Milan) gets on the end of a good pass and from mid-range he unleashes a decent strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
52' Strahinja Pavlovic (AC Milan) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.
50' Alexis Saelemaekers (AC Milan) attempts to find one of his teammates, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Genoa.
48' Aaron Martin (Genoa) attempts to find one of his teammates with a fine lofted pass, but the defence reacts well to intercept the effort.
47' Christian Pulisic (AC Milan) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
46' Massimiliano Allegri has decided to make a substitution during the half-time break. Ruben Loftus-Cheek (AC Milan) comes on the pitch for Youssouf Fofana.
46' The second half has just started.
45+2' Maurizio Mariani has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45' The fourth official shows 1 min. of added time.
44' Fikayo Tomori (AC Milan) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision!
42' AC Milan are showcasing great team work and neat passing moves.
39' Christian Pulisic (AC Milan) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Maurizio Mariani blows his whistle for a foul.

38' The keeper doesn't have to worry about this one. Aaron Martin (Genoa) sacrificed accuracy for power, and thus his attempt went well over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for AC Milan.
37' Lorenzo Colombo (Genoa) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.
37' CHANCE! Rafael Leao (AC Milan) connects with a cross but he cannot direct his shot on target.
34' Davide Bartesaghi (AC Milan) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.
31' Luka Modric (AC Milan) takes the corner which is cleared by the opposition's defence.

28' 0 - 1 Ruslan Malinovskyi sends a precise lofted cross into the box. Lorenzo Colombo (Genoa) latches on to it and finishes with a quick shot into the bottom left corner. The goalkeeper had no chance. The score changes to 0:1.

26' Youssouf Fofana (AC Milan) sends over a cross from the side into the penalty area in order to find one of his teammates, but he fails and the opportunity goes begging. The ball has crossed the sideline. Genoa are taking a throw-in.
24' Lorenzo Colombo (Genoa) meets the free kick and unleashes a header from the edge of the box, but it's not powerful enough to trouble Mike Maignan.

23' The game is interrupted. Davide Bartesaghi (AC Milan) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did. Genoa have been awarded a free kick.
21' Rafael Leao (AC Milan) fires a powerful shot which is blocked.
19' Rafael Leao (AC Milan) gets on the ball and beats an opponent, but his run is stopped by the referee Maurizio Mariani who sees an offensive foul.
18' PENALTY APPEAL by Genoa, but the referee thinks it was a fair challenge and play continues!
17' A poor mid-range free-kick by Strahinja Pavlovic (AC Milan) is easily blocked by the defensive wall.

15' Morten Thorsby (Genoa) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Maurizio Mariani blows his whistle for an infringement. AC Milan are awarded a free kick from a dangerous position.
14' A promising cross into the box is nearly received by the lurking Rafael Leao (AC Milan), but one of the defending players cuts it out to avert the threat.
13' A cross is clipped into the penalty area by Ruslan Malinovskyi (Genoa) but poses no threat. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for AC Milan.
11' Genoa have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.

9' Alexis Saelemaekers swings in a perfect cross for Strahinja Pavlovic (AC Milan), who unfortunately sends a poor header high over the bar from the centre of the box. The ball goes out of play and Genoa will have a goal kick.
8' Matteo Gabbia (AC Milan) connects with a cross near the penalty spot and produces a header which hits the crossbar!
7' AC Milan work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
7' Youssouf Fofana (AC Milan) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. The ball goes out of play and AC Milan have been awarded a corner kick.
6' The resulting set piece from AC Milan is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
6' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Youssouf Fofana (AC Milan) is thwarted and cleared to safety. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for AC Milan.
2' Genoa hold possession of the ball and display neat passing from player to player. They are waiting for the right moment to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
Genoa will kick the game off.
Maurizio Mariani got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
